title: Choose scalar or primitive collection storage explicitly
goal: Use PrimitiveCollection when overriding convention to store a primitive sequence, including an ambiguous byte array; use Property for a binary scalar when migrating EF Core 10 configuration to EF Core 11.

selectionNotes: Primitive collection configuration, including ambiguous byte arrays. PrimitiveCollection selects sequence semantics; Property selects scalar semantics in EF11. Provider storage and existing data migration must be checked separately.
The EF10 comparison is historical evidence, not an additional .NET 10 foundation or a claim EF11 runs on net10.0.

runtime.name: .NET

prerequisites: Copy the complete project and configuration files below into a standalone directory. Restore the pinned package graph online before running; Playbook retrieval is offline, consumer dependency setup is separate.
The open SQLite connection owns the transient database lifetime. Closing it removes all sample data; no account, external database or persistent schema is provisioned.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API shape in GA-targeted guidance, measured on RC2 packages and SDK. No experimental API suppression required. Actual GA reconciliation remains outstanding.

evidence.scope: Actual model collection/scalar classification, SQLite JSON array/TEXT versus BLOB storage, fresh-context insert/read/update, sequence order and duplicates, and EF10/11 Property classification control.
